gloss: to omit; to leave out reluctantly

definitions.gloss: to omit; to leave out reluctantly; to cut for brevity
definitions.explanation: To reluctantly leave something out, typically due to time or space constraints. Implies that the omitted content has value and the speaker regrets not being able to include it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{詳細|しょうさい}→詳細：02523_shousai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{割愛|かつあい}します。
⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{都合|つごう}→都合：01672_tsugou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧{割愛|かつあい}させて⟦いただきます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: Due to time constraints, I will have to leave some parts out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{紙面|しめん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{割愛|かつあい}する。
examples.english: There's a lot I'd like to introduce, but I'll have to leave it out due to limited space.

notes:
Originally meant to part reluctantly with something one loves (⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧ = love, {割|か}つ = to cut). The modern usage retains this nuance of reluctant omission — you would include the content if you could, but constraints prevent it. Very common in presentations, speeches, and written articles.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{割愛|かつあい}する: to omit the explanation
- ⟦{詳細|しょうさい}→詳細：02523_shousai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{割愛|かつあい}→割愛：14763_katsuai⟧: details omitted
- {紙面|しめん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{都合|つごう}→都合：01672_tsugou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{割愛|かつあい}→割愛：14763_katsuai⟧: omitted due to space constraints
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{都合|つごう}→都合：01672_tsugou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{割愛|かつあい}→割愛：14763_katsuai⟧: omitted due to time constraints

USAGE:
This is a formal, polite way to tell an audience or reader that you are skipping something. Using ⟦{割愛|かつあい}→割愛：14763_katsuai⟧ signals respect for both the omitted content and the audience. It is a staple of academic presentations, business meetings, and journalistic writing.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{省略|しょうりゃく}→省略：03244_shouryaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to abbreviate, to omit — more neutral; no connotation of reluctance
- ⟦{省|はぶ}く→省く：02398_habuku⟧: to cut, to leave out — more casual and direct
